selected_priority: Fuse fresh CompanyFitAssessment intelligence into recruiter-facing application strategy without turning company signals into candidate claims.
displaced_capability: Helix could independently score explicit job requirements and fresh company direction, but the company-fit result did not alter the resume, cover letter, outreach, application packet, or strategy receipt recruiters actually receive.

mechanisms_compared.assessment: Preserve project_requirement_aware_application and its existing lifecycle contract, then compose CompanyFitAssessment as an optional extension rather than replacing the proven requirement-aware projection path.
Make company intelligence a mandatory new projection input and replace the prior strategy API, which would increase coupling and break existing callers without adding proportional recruiter value.

Keep requirement evidence and company intelligence as separate truth domains, map only matched company signals that independently resolve to strong supplied candidate evidence, then inject those mappings into recruiter copy while preserving company-source provenance in machine-readable strategy receipts.
